findings.problem: The example uses words not met before this card: bruja, príncipe, rana. In the frequency phase it may use at most two words not met yet.

back.example: The witch turned the prince into a frog.

note: Much of this word's subtitle frequency comes from reflexive convertirse en (to become), so the editor might mention it in a later card or note; transformar is a rarer near-synonym but is not the natural answer to "to turn into".
